ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Motion capture and generative effects can fill in for extras, but lead-level emotion and live presence still come down to the actor.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 57,000 actors employed in 2024, rising to a projected 57,100 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 100 jobs and about 6,300 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $60,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace lead actors, but it is taking over extras and stand-ins. Motion capture, digital doubles, and generative effects speed up routine shots, pushing actors from looks toward characterization and recognizability. What gets squeezed out is pure background and mechanical performance; people who can build a character are worth more.

Role matching recommendations
Emotional performance analysis
Line pronunciation correction
ai_s2_auto: Motion capture replaces extras
Digital doubles fill shots
Generative effects compositing
Automated lip sync

Live reaction: the spark comes from a person.
Emotional empathy: the truth comes from a person.
Physical control: the calibration comes from a person.
On-set collaboration: the chemistry comes from a person.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 puts this occupation in the low AI exposure performance zone: effects can fill the background, but character and emotion still leave room for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean zero risk. What gets replaced is the work of extras and stand-ins, not the lead performance role. Actors who can build a character and carry a scene get scarcer as the technology spreads. The ones at risk only know how to stand in the background.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Drill performance, lines, movement, and your reel. Pure background work is shrinking in the AI era, so start building characterization early.
Move from bit parts to building characters, accumulate credits and recognizability, and go for lead roles.
Highlight the roles and credits you have, and name the productions you worked on. Crews value reliability and acting chops.
Do not cast on looks alone; look for whether the person thinks about character. Actors who can carry a scene deserve the good roles.

ai_s7_trends: Digital doubles take over extras.
Streaming pulls up demand for content.
Actors who can build a character are in higher demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代主角级演员，但会吃群演与替身。动作捕捉、数字替身与生成式特效把常规镜头提速，演员从「靠脸」挪向「靠角色塑造与辨识度」。真正被挤掉的是纯背景与机械表演，有塑造力的人更值钱。

角色匹配推荐

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于零风险：被替代的是「群演、替身」动作，不是「主角表演」的岗位。有塑造力、能扛戏的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会站背景的演员。

Select people for rigor and calm; provide roles to those who can carry responsibility for life.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify an opponent's weakest movement patterns and predict injury risk, but an athlete's body alone determines whether training translates into performance on game day.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows that about 19,100 athletes and sports competitors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 20,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,100 jobs, with roughly 2,100 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $62,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace athletes, but it will redefine how they train. Data analysis identifies what to practice, video analysis reveals an opponent's weaknesses, and wearables monitor fatigue and injury risk. AI makes training more scientific and can extend careers, but competitive sport remains a contest of bodies and wills. Machines extract efficiency; people still perform in competition.
ai_s2_accel: AI tactical simulation for pregame preparation
Wearables that monitor fatigue and injury risk in real time
Computer vision analysis of movement details to optimize technique
Data analysis supporting talent identification and transfer evaluation
ai_s2_auto: Automatic editing and analysis of competition data and video
Automatic recording of training load and physical metrics
Automatic reports on opponents' technical and tactical data
Systematic statistics from fitness testing
ai_s3_list: Game-day execution: machines cannot calculate the decisive moment of performance.
Physical limits: the body must ultimately deliver the results of training.
Will and psychology: perseverance and adjustment during deficits and injuries.
Competitive instinct: choices made in an instant.
Team chemistry: the connection among players during competition.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 means direct AI replacement risk is extremely low because human bodies and real-time performance are the basis of competition. AI acts more like a strategist, analyzing opponents, optimizing training, and warning of injuries so athletes train smarter and recover faster instead of replacing them in competition.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk does not permit inaction. Athletes who use data analysis and cooperate with scientific rehabilitation can extend their careers and strengthen competitiveness. In a data-driven era, athletes who train blindly on talent alone will gradually fall behind.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Before pursuing elite competition, understand the risks. It is a narrow path with a high attrition rate and short career span. If a child has exceptional talent and genuine commitment, prepare both academics and career planning. Data and scientific training are changing the industry, so early exposure is useful.

Use data analysis and scientific rehabilitation. Learn to read your training data and work proactively with conditioning staff to manage your body. Plan the post-retirement transition early through coaching, rehabilitation, or sports management instead of waiting until your competitive career ends.

Switching careers to become a professional athlete is rarely realistic, but sports-industry paths such as data analysis, sports rehabilitation, and event operations remain accessible. Translating enthusiasm for sports into professional skills is more practical than insisting on competing.

Do not evaluate athletes solely by results. Combine injury history, training data, and psychological resilience. Providing strong rehabilitation and career-planning support is responsible to athletes and extends the value of the team roster.

Advances in injury prediction and rehabilitation reduce careers cut short during peak years.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出对手最薄弱的跑位，也能预测你的伤病风险，但比赛那天能不能把训练成果打出来——那一下只有运动员自己的身体说了算。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运动员与体育竞赛选手在岗约 1.91 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.02 万人，净增约 0.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.21 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.24 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运动员，但会重新定义「怎么练」：数据分析告诉你该练什么、录像分析告诉你对手怕什么、可穿戴设备盯着你的疲劳和伤病风险。AI 让训练更科学、让职业寿命更长，但竞技体育的本质是身体与意志的对抗——机器负责把效率榨出来，场上那一下还得靠人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 战术模拟辅助赛前准备
可穿戴设备实时监测疲劳与伤病风险
计算机视觉分析动作细节优化技术
数据分析辅助选材与转会评估
ai_s2_auto: 比赛数据与录像自动剪辑分析
训练负荷与身体指标自动记录
对手技战术数据自动生成报告
体能测试数据系统化统计
ai_s3_list: 临场发挥：机器算不出比赛那一下的执行。
身体极限：训练成果最终要靠身体兑现。
意志与心理：落后、伤停时的坚持与调整。
比赛直觉：电光石火间的选择。
团队默契：场上球员之间的化学反应。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业被 AI 直接替代的风险极低：竞技表现的主体是人的身体和临场发挥。AI 更多是「军师」——分析对手、优化训练、预警伤病，帮运动员练得更聪明、恢复得更快，而不是取代运动员上场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低风险不等于可以不动：会用数据分析、能配合科学康复的运动员，职业寿命和竞争力都更强。数据驱动的时代里，「只靠天赋蛮练」的运动员会逐渐掉队。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走竞技路线前先想清楚风险：这是淘汰率高、职业寿命短的窄门。如果孩子天赋突出且真爱，就做好文化课和职业规划两手准备；数据与科学训练正在改变这个行业，早点接触没有坏处。
把数据分析和科学康复用起来，学会读自己的训练数据，主动配合体能师管理身体。同时尽早规划退役转型——教练、康复、体育管理都是方向，别等退役再抓瞎。
转行当职业运动员几乎不现实，但可以进入体育产业：数据分析、运动康复、赛事运营都是入口。把对体育的热爱翻译成专业技能，比执着于上场更可行。
评估运动员别只看成绩单，要结合伤病史、训练数据和心理素质综合判断。给运动员配足康复和职业规划支持，既是对他们负责，也是延长队伍资产。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated monitoring stations can collect routine measurements, but technicians still choose sampling locations, interpret anomalies, and connect environmental conditions with health.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, about 40,400 Environmental Science And Protection Technicians, Including Health were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 42,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,700 jobs, with about 5,600 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $49,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Environmental Science And Protection Technicians, Including Health, but it will reduce routine roles. Automated monitoring stations and sensors take over sampling and readings, shifting technicians from routine collection toward sampling design, anomaly analysis, compliance communication, and health interpretation. Standard-sampling roles face the most pressure, while people who can analyze data and identify anomalies become more valuable.

Health connections: people interpret the evidence.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure in monitoring work. Systems accelerate routine sampling, but people still interpret findings and manage compliance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces standardized sampling tasks, not sampling design and interpretation. People who can analyze data and identify anomalies become scarcer as digitization expands. Technicians limited to checklist sampling face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with environmental science, chemistry, or testing, then develop analysis skills and relevant credentials early. Routine sampling work is shrinking.
Move beyond sampling into analysis and compliance, and learn to interpret automated-station data.
Emphasize relevant credentials, the media you can test, and the industries in which you have worked.
Do not evaluate candidates only on sampling ability. Check whether they can interpret anomalies and write sound reports.

People remain essential for interpretation and compliance.
Connections between environmental conditions and health are receiving more attention.

body: Environmental Science And Protection Technicians, Including Health conduct environmental sampling, monitoring, and laboratory analysis under professional supervision. They organize data and support environmental compliance and occupational health judgments on the front line.

Pallet balance judgment: an unstable stack endangers an entire shipment.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score places this occupation in a relatively low AI exposure range. Most time is spent on physical tasks, leaving few desk-based actions for algorithms to standardize beyond picking lists and records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A low score does not guarantee safety. AGVs and robotic arms reduce purely manual handling, so the major variable is automation equipment itself. Workers who operate forklifts, collaborate with equipment, and handle nonstandard situations are more secure, while jobs limited to carrying are slowly narrowing.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is an accessible transitional job suited to short-term employment. For a long-term career, learn forklift, logistics, or equipment-operation skills rather than relying only on physical strength.

Earn a forklift credential and learn electric pallet trucks and palletizing. Advance from manual handling to equipment operation plus multiple roles, then move toward forklift driver or warehouse associate.

The work is quick to learn and suits a fast transition or peak-season earnings. For stability, choose a regulated distribution center with equipment; forklift skills are worth more than manual handling alone.

Do not hire only for strength. Assess safety awareness and multi-station ability. Workers who operate forklifts, understand palletizing, and follow safety rules are especially valuable during automation transitions.

E-commerce logistics volume is growing, and nonstandard and last-mile settings still need people. Handling demand will transform rather than disappear.
Material movers are developing combined forklift-driving, warehousing, and dispatch skills; specialization provides the path forward.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低分不等于安全。AGV 和机械臂正在减少纯人力搬运，真正的变数是自动化设备本身。会开叉车、懂设备协作、能处理非标场景的搬运工更稳，纯「搬」的岗位在慢慢收窄。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这是门槛最低的过渡性工作，适合短期就业。想长期发展，学叉车、物流或设备操作技能，比纯体力更有出路。
考叉车证、学电动托盘车和码板技巧，从「纯搬运」升级为「设备操作+多工种」，往叉车司机、仓管方向走。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace infantry, but it will change their equipment and fighting style: drone reconnaissance, intelligent target recognition, and individual soldier information systems allow infantry to "see further and fight more accurately." However, machines cannot replace the core tasks of occupation, defense, close combat, and field survival. The transformation direction of the infantry is towards "information-based individual soldiers" - those who can operate unmanned equipment and digital terminals are more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 shows that the core of infantry is physical fitness, tactics and coordination. What AI can transform is the intelligence, reconnaissance and equipment levels. "People fight on the ground" will not change in the short term. The score reflects the upgrade of equipment and fighting methods, not the disappearance of positions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean unchanged: Modern infantry are becoming more and more like "information nodes" - soldiers who can operate drones, use individual terminals, and understand digital communications will have wider room for growth and transformation paths in the army. In the future, infantrymen will not only compete for physical strength, but also the ability to control equipment.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Before joining the army, think clearly about your motivation and physical ability. The military can temper people and provide protection, but it is also a high-intensity disciplined life; it allows children to exercise physical fitness and understand service policies in advance, so that they can develop more if they are admitted to military academies or take the path of technical arms.

During his service, he took the initiative to learn information equipment, drone operation and communication skills, and participated in training and military competitions to perform meritorious service. You need to plan early whether you want to be admitted to the military academy or become a non-commissioned officer. Don't just be a "physical" soldier.

Decommissioning transformation is a systematic project: using decommissioning resettlement policies, vocational skills training and academic qualification improvement plans, the discipline, leadership and equipment skills learned by the troops are transferred to security, firefighting, construction machinery and other directions.

Retired military personnel are a high-quality recruitment pool: they have strong discipline, strong resistance to pressure, and good execution ability. Giving retired soldiers clear skills certification channels and career plans during recruitment is more effective in retaining people than simply "emotional recruitment".

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代步兵，但会改变步兵的装备和打法：无人机侦察、智能目标识别、单兵信息系统让步兵「看得更远、打得更准」，但占领、防守、近距离作战和野战生存这些核心任务，机器代替不了。步兵的转型方向是「信息化单兵」——会操作无人装备和数字终端的人更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于不变：现代步兵越来越像「信息化节点」——会操作无人机、会用单兵终端、懂数字通信的士兵，在部队的成长空间和转型路径都更宽。未来步兵拼的不只是体力，还有装备驾驭能力。

服役期间主动学信息化装备、无人机操作和通信技能，参加集训比武立功。考军校提干或转士官都要趁早规划，别只当「体能型」士兵。
退役转型是系统工程：利用退役安置政策、职业技能培训和学历提升计划，把部队学的纪律、领导力和装备技能迁移到安保、消防、工程机械等方向。
退役军人是优质招聘池：纪律性强、抗压强、执行力好。招聘时给退役士兵明确的技能认证通道和职业规划，比单纯「情怀招聘」更能留人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically generate CNC programs and optimize cutting parameters, but setup feel, tool-setting precision, and judgment when tolerances are exceeded still depend on experienced machinists.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 299,500 machinists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 299,600 by 2034. That represents roughly 100 additional jobs and about 29,500 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $56,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace machinists, but it will raise the technical threshold. CAM software and AI-assisted programming are simplifying program creation, while CNC conversion reduces basic manual-operation roles. Yet machines cannot replace hands-on skills in setup, tool setting, measurement, and exception diagnosis. Machinists who can program, understand processes, and produce high-precision parts become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted process planning
In-process measurement and closed-loop compensation
Digital-twin virtual test cutting
Wider adoption of robotic loading and unloading
ai_s2_auto: Automatic CNC program generation
AI optimization of cutting parameters
Intelligent tool-life management

ai_s3_list: Setup and tool-setting feel: even the best program fails if the reference point is wrong.
Precision judgment: experience is needed to identify the causes behind measurement errors.
Awareness of tools and cutting conditions: skilled machinists detect problems through sound, sparks, and vibration.
Exception handling: people must respond immediately to crashes, broken tools, and out-of-tolerance parts.
Accumulated process improvement: experienced machinists know how to make production more stable and faster.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means AI is assisting about half of the programming and parameter-setting work. Programs, toolpaths, and parameters can be automated, but people still control machining quality and on-site judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. AI lowers the programming barrier while raising the process-knowledge threshold. Basic operator roles are shrinking, but machinists who can diagnose problems, understand processes, and produce precision parts become scarcer and more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Vocational programs in CNC machining or mechanical processing are a reliable choice, followed by entry as an operator apprentice. Build strong skills in blueprint reading, measuring instruments, and CNC programming (G-code + CAM) while in school; these are the foundation for resilience against AI disruption.

Move from conventional machines to CNC and multi-axis equipment as soon as possible, and become proficient with CAM and AI-assisted programming. Develop toward moldmaking, five-axis machining, and high-precision work while avoiding purely manual-operation roles.

A mechanical background helps, but beginners can start as apprentices and first master measuring instruments and blueprint reading. On your résumé, specify the machines you have operated, the tolerance levels you have achieved, and the programming methods you know.

Do not hire based only on the ability to start and run a machine; assess blueprint-reading and process capabilities. Machinists who independently adjust programs, correct out-of-tolerance conditions, and train apprentices are worth retaining with higher pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Tool-life prediction and automatic tool changes

ai_s7_trends: As CNC and five-axis machining spread, machinists shift from operating machines to programming, process engineering, and judgment, while basic operator roles continue to shrink.
As AI-assisted programming and in-process measurement mature, entry barriers fall, but high-precision process expertise becomes more valuable.
As flexible manufacturing and automated lines spread, demand rises for versatile technicians who understand equipment maintenance and program optimization.

body: Machinists use lathes, milling machines, grinders, and CNC equipment to turn metal blanks into qualified parts according to engineering drawings and process requirements. They handle setup, tool setting, cutting, measurement, quality inspection, and equipment maintenance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automatically generate CNC programs and optimize cutting parameters, but setup feel, tool-setting precision, and judgment when tolerances are exceeded still depend on experienced machinists.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机械加工工在岗约 29.95 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 29.96 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.95 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.62 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代机械加工工，但会抬高技术门槛。CAM 软件和 AI 辅助编程正把「写程序」变得简单，数控化改造在压缩基础手动操作岗；但装夹、对刀、测量、异常判断这些现场手艺，机器替代不了。会编程、懂工艺、能做高精度件的师傅，价值反而更高。

在线测量与闭环补偿

ai_s3_list: 装夹与对刀的手感：基准找不准，程序再好也白搭。
精度判断：测量数据背后的误差原因，靠经验分析。
刀具与切削的感知：声音、火花、振动，听得出问题。
异常处置：撞刀、断刀、超差，当场处理靠人。
工艺改进的积累：怎么更稳更快，靠老师傅的经验。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半「编程与参数」环节正被 AI 辅助——程序、刀路、参数都能自动化，但现场加工的质量与判断还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 降低的是编程门槛，抬高的是工艺门槛——基础操作员被压缩，但会判断、懂工艺、能做精密件的师傅反而更稀缺、更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读技校数控、机械加工专业是稳妥选择，毕业后从操作学徒起步。在校把识图、量具、数控编程（G 代码+CAM）学扎实，这是抗 AI 冲击的底子。
尽快从普通机床转向数控和多轴，把 CAM 和 AI 辅助编程用熟。往模具、五轴、高精度方向走，避开纯手动操作岗。
有机械底子最好，无经验可从学徒做起，先把量具和识图练熟。简历上多写「操作过哪些机床、做过哪些精度等级的活、会什么编程」。
招人别只要求会开机，要看识图和工艺能力。能独立调程序、处理超差、带学徒的师傅，值得高薪留。

ai_s7_trends: 数控化与五轴普及，加工工从「开机」转向「编程+工艺+判断」，基础操作岗持续压缩。

That is a net increase of about 62,400 jobs, with roughly 159,800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $48,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace general maintenance and repair workers, but it will take over work-order routing, spare-parts management, and recordkeeping. On-site diagnosis and hands-on repair remain genuine trades that machines cannot replace in the short term.

Systematic spare-parts inventory management

Intelligent inspection scheduling
ai_s3_list: On-site diagnosis: repair descriptions are often inaccurate, so experience reveals the actual fault.
Multi-trade craftsmanship: competence in plumbing, electrical, carpentry, masonry, and HVAC develops over years.
Safe operation: energized work, elevated work, and sewage all require strict procedures.
Communication and coordination: residents demand action, specialists need scheduling, and supervisors monitor progress.
Emergency response: burst pipes at midnight and trapped elevator passengers require immediate action.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means repair requests, spare parts, and records form a substantial part of the job and systems are taking them over. On-site diagnosis and hands-on repair remain the human domain, leaving limited room for AI replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean the work stays unchanged. AI routes tickets, manages parts, and suggests diagnoses, but hands still complete the repair. Pressure falls on helpers who only replace light bulbs or clean. Buildings still depend on versatile maintenance workers who understand plumbing and electricity, service refrigeration, and solve difficult faults.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter the field, study electrical work or plumbing at a technical school and earn an electrician credential. In the AI era, do not learn only component replacement; build plumbing, electrical, refrigeration, and low-voltage skills. Broader ability creates stability, and all-round maintenance workers remain scarce.

Let systems handle repair tickets and spare parts while you develop integrated maintenance and energy-efficiency retrofit skills. Earn refrigeration and low-voltage credentials and advance toward engineering supervision or specialized repair instead of stopping at light-bulb replacement.

Before changing careers into maintenance, earn credentials and begin in property maintenance. On a résumé, results such as independently resolving XX types of faults or maintaining XX buildings are more useful than a list of skills.

Test safety procedures before craftsmanship when hiring maintenance workers; reject anyone careless about energized work. Prioritize credentialed people with multiple skills, and offer credential subsidies to improve retention.

Early alerts for plumbing and electrical abnormalities
Power drill, angle grinder, and rotary hammer

Demand for integrated maintenance and energy-efficiency retrofits grows, increasing the value of multi-skilled maintenance workers.
Smart devices enter buildings, making maintenance workers with low-voltage and smart-home expertise scarce.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代通用维修工，但会接管报修分单、备件管理和记录。剩下的现场诊断、动手修复，是实打实的手艺，机器短期替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助故障诊断建议
红外热像定位渗漏与过热点
传感器监测水电异常预警
AR 辅助查看管线图纸

备件库存系统化管理
维修记录自动生成
巡检计划智能排期
ai_s3_list: 现场诊断：报修描述常不准，真实故障靠经验去查。
多工种手艺：水电木瓦暖样样能上手，是长期积累。
安全操作：带电、登高、污水，哪一样都得按规程。
沟通协调：住户催、专业师傅约、主管盯，都得摆平。
应急处置：半夜爆管、电梯困人，第一时间到场处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的报修、备件、记录比重不低，这些正被系统接管；但现场诊断与动手维修是人的主战场，AI 替代空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变。AI 帮你分单、管备件、给诊断建议，但「修好」永远靠手。真正被挤压的是只会换灯泡、扫地的纯杂工；懂水电、会制冷、能处理疑难故障的综合维修工，楼宇里离不开。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入这行，技校学电工或水暖，把电工证考到手。AI 时代别只学换件，把水电、制冷、弱电都学起来——会得越多越稳，全能维修工永远缺人。
把报修单和备件交给系统，往综合维保、节能改造方向学。考制冷、弱电等证书，往工程主管或专项维修走，别让技能停在换灯泡。
转行维修工先考证再入行，从物业维修工做起。简历写「独立处理过XX类故障、负责XX栋楼日常维保」这类成果，比罗列技能有用。
招维修工先考安全规程再考手艺，带电作业都不讲究的不能要。优先招持证、会多项技能的，给考证补贴能留住人。

综合维保与节能改造需求增长，会多项技能的维修工更吃香。
智能设备进楼宇，懂弱电与智能家居的维修工稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 320,400 nurse practitioners employed in 2024, projected to rise to 448,800 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 128,400 jobs, with roughly 29,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $129,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace nurse practitioners, but it will take over the most time-consuming documentation and screening. Draft medical records, triage suggestions, medication reminders, and follow-up notifications can all be automated, shifting nurse practitioners' time from writing records toward treating and communicating with patients. Machines cannot replace diagnostic reasoning, prescribing decisions, and patient trust.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted diagnostic suggestions and drug-interaction alerts
Expansion of telehealth and online follow-up platforms
Continuous monitoring through chronic-disease management apps
Wearable-device data supporting health-management decisions
ai_s2_auto: Draft medical records and structured data entry
Preliminary triage and symptom-screening suggestions
Medication reminders and return-visit notifications
Structured organization of routine laboratory reports
ai_s3_list: Face-to-face consultation: finding the real problem in details of the chief complaint.
Diagnostic reasoning: similar symptoms can have entirely different causes.
Treatment decisions: weighing benefits and risks and giving patients a clear recommendation.
Patient communication: explaining care so patients understand and follow it.
Continuity of care: therapeutic trust built over years of follow-up.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score means AI is deeply transforming procedural work such as records, triage, and reminders. However, clinical judgment and patient relationships are the core value. Nurse practitioners must still assess, prescribe, and follow up personally. The score reflects high documentation exposure, not high occupational risk.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Nurse practitioners who use AI-assisted diagnosis and remote follow-up tools see patients more efficiently and serve more people. AI amplifies their capacity, making skilled users more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Nursing is a dependable path, but advanced practice requires graduate study. If the family can support it and the student is willing to learn long-term, a bachelor's + master's degree in nursing opens substantially broader employment options.

Transition from registered nurse to nurse practitioner by first completing a master's degree and certification. Master chronic-disease management, remote follow-up, and AI-assisted tools and pursue community care and independent practice.

People with nursing backgrounds should prioritize an NP track, while others can begin with a bachelor's degree in nursing. In interviews, independent patient-care and chronic-disease management experience is more persuasive than credentials alone.

Primary care routinely lacks nurse practitioners. Retain them through independent-practice authority + advanced-study support + reasonable scheduling, and prioritize candidates who use digital follow-up tools.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年执业护士在岗约 32.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 44.88 万人，净增约 12.84 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.95 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代执业护士，但会接管最费时的文书和筛查：病历初稿、分诊建议、用药提醒、随访通知都能自动化，执业护士的时间从「写病历」转向「看病和沟通」。诊断推理、处方决策和医患信任，这些核心环节机器替代不了。

远程问诊与线上随访平台扩容

初步分诊与症状筛查建议

诊断推理：症状相似，病因可以完全不同。
治疗决策：权衡获益与风险，给患者拍板建议。

连续照护：多年随访里建立的治疗信任。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：会用 AI 辅助诊断、远程随访工具的执业护士，接诊效率更高、能服务更多患者。AI 是放大执业护士产能的工具，用得好的护士更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 护理是条踏实的路，但要往「高级执业」走需要读研。家里条件允许、孩子愿意长期学习，选护理本科 + 硕士，就业面会宽很多。
从注册护士往执业护士转，先补硕士学历和认证。把慢病管理、远程随访和 AI 辅助工具用熟，往社区医疗和独立执业方向走。
有护理背景的优先读 NP 方向；没背景的可以从护理本科起步。面试时突出独立接诊和慢病管理的经历，比单纯证书更有说服力。
基层医疗缺执业护士是常态，用「独立执业授权 + 进修支持 + 合理排班」留人；会数字化随访工具的候选人优先。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 46,400 general pediatricians were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 46,800, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 1,200 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $210,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pediatricians, but it will change how they work. AI takes over much desk work such as clinical documentation, initial imaging review, and laboratory interpretation, while clinical decision support provides medication reminders. Machines cannot replace history taking, physical examinations, individualized pediatric medication decisions, or communication with patients and families. Pediatricians are not disappearing; they are being freed from documentation to spend more time with patients.
ai_s2_accel: AI clinical decision support provides medication and diagnostic suggestions
Smart triage orders visits by urgency
Child health data platforms support long-term follow-up
Remote pediatric consultations and community-provider collaboration spread
ai_s2_auto: Digital clinical documentation and records processing
AI initial screening and prioritization of imaging reports
Automated interpretation prompts for routine laboratory results
Automated plotting and assessment of child growth curves
ai_s3_list: Clinical judgment in history taking and physical examinations: children cannot describe symptoms, so physicians must ask, listen, and examine.
Individualized pediatric medication management: small differences in dose, formulation, or contraindications can be dangerous.
Real-time management of critical emergencies: febrile seizures and foreign-body aspiration demand rapid judgment and action.
Communication and trust with families: explaining conditions and easing anxiety are part of treatment.
Sensitivity to children's psychology: physicians must recognize what children fear and what parents worry about.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates that AI is taking over more than half of this occupation's desk tasks, including documentation, initial screening, and routine interpretation, creating clear efficiency gains.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. The stronger AI becomes, the more physicians can leave documentation behind and focus on clinical judgment and communication, precisely the two capabilities most scarce in pediatrics. A model limited to orders and records faces pressure, while pediatricians who understand children and communicate well become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choosing clinical medicine requires long-term preparation: an undergraduate degree plus residency training takes nearly ten years. Choose pediatrics only if you genuinely enjoy working with children, and plan for the psychological and physical demands. Pediatricians are scarce, so those who persist become valuable resources.

Use AI-assisted diagnosis and child health data platforms to leave documentation behind and focus on specialties and patient education. Develop a differentiated path in child health, growth and development, or a pediatric subspecialty.

Moving from another clinical field into pediatrics requires residency training and assessment; the path is long but worthwhile. People without medical backgrounds can explore related roles such as pediatric nursing or child-health assistant. Highlight pediatric rotation experience and communication with children on your resume.

When hiring pediatricians, evaluate clinical fundamentals, resilience, and communication, not publications alone. Physicians who handle outpatient volume and communicate effectively with parents are essential team members.

Automated plotting and assessment of growth and development
Generate educational graphics, articles, and follow-up reminders

Child health management, growth and development, and behavioral health clinics are becoming growth areas, extending pediatric services from treating illness to managing health across the life cycle.
Long-term pediatrician shortages persist, while community pediatrics and online consultations expand. Pediatricians skilled in communication and patient education are increasingly scarce.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年儿科医师、普通在岗约 4.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.68 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.12 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 21.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代儿科医生，但会改变工作方式。病历书写、影像初筛、化验判读这些桌面活被 AI 大量接手，临床决策支持也能给用药提醒；但问诊查体、儿童用药的个体化把握和医患沟通，机器替代不了。儿科医生不是变少，而是从「写病历」里解放出来，把时间还给患者。

智能分诊按紧急度安排就诊顺序

ai_s3_list: 问诊与查体的临床判断：孩子不会描述，全靠医生的问、听、查。
儿童用药的个体化把握：剂量、剂型、禁忌，差之毫厘都危险。
急重症的临场处置：高热惊厥、异物吸入，判断和操作要快。
与家长的沟通与信任：解释病情、安抚焦虑，是治疗的一部分。
对儿童心理的敏感：孩子怕什么、家长担心什么，医生要看得见。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有一半以上桌面任务正被 AI 接手——文书、初筛、常规判读，效率提升明显。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 越强，医生越要从「文书劳动」里解放出来做临床判断和沟通——这两样恰恰是儿科最稀缺的能力。真正被挤压的是「只会开单写病历」的模式，会看孩子、会沟通的儿科医生更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选临床医学要有长期准备：本科加规培近十年。真心喜欢孩子再选儿科，同时规划好心理和体能；儿科人才缺，坚持下来是稀缺资源。
把 AI 辅助诊断和儿童健康数据平台用起来，从「写病历」里解放出来做专科和患教。往儿童保健、生长发育或亚专科方向走，形成差异化。
临床转儿科需要规培和考核，路长但值得；非医学背景可关注儿科护理、儿保助理等周边岗位。简历上突出儿科轮转经验和儿童沟通能力。
招儿科医生别只看论文，要看临床基本功和抗压沟通。能扛门诊强度、会跟家长沟通的医生，是儿科团队最需要的骨干。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 19,400 workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 20,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 900 jobs, with about 1,500 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $59,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace reinforcing iron and rebar workers; it will only automate part of quantity calculation. Software accelerates detailing and cutting optimization, but on-site tying, positioning, work at height, coordination, and inspection judgment still depend on people. Pure material handling faces the greatest pressure, while workers who read drawings and prepare bar schedules become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Joint detailing assistance
Smart waste optimization
Progress visualization
Safety wearables and alerts
ai_s2_auto: Detailing, cutting, and quantity calculations
Automated rebar bending
BIM layout verification
Automated material delivery
ai_s3_list: People are needed for tying at height.
People are needed for complex joints.
People are needed to judge reinforcement inspections.
People are needed for on-site coordination.
People are needed to uphold safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation among on-site trades with low AI exposure. The work depends heavily on hand-eye coordination and site conditions, while systems mainly assist with quantity calculations and layouts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no risk. Automation replaces cutting and quantity calculations, not jobs involving tying at height. Rebar workers who read drawings, prepare bar schedules, and work confidently at height are becoming scarcer as prefabrication expands. Workers who only move materials and cannot read drawings face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: At vocational school, practice drawing interpretation and bar detailing. Pure material handling is shrinking, so learn detailed design early.
Advance from tying to detailing + crew leadership by learning BIM and cutting software.
Highlight the project types and floor levels you have worked on. Construction sites value reliability and precision.
Do not select workers based only on strength; look for drawing interpretation and joint experience. Core workers who prepare bar schedules merit higher daily pay.

ai_s7_trends: Prefabrication reduces the volume of on-site work.
Rebar detailing software is becoming widespread.
People are still required for complex joints.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人在岗约 1.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.03 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.15 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.93 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。

安全穿戴预警

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的现场工种区——活儿高度依赖手眼和现场，系统主要帮算量和排布。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校起步多练识图和翻样，纯搬运在缩，早点学深化。
从「绑扎」升级成「翻样 + 带班」，学 BIM 和下料软件。
突出跟过的项目类型和楼层经验，工地看重稳和准。
选人别只看力气，要看识图和节点经验。会翻样的骨干值得给高日薪。

ai_s7_trends: 预制装配吃现场量。
翻样软件普及。
